messages.welcome: Hello! I'm Kural from CrackLeap 👋 We learn by building, mentored by engineers who ship. Which track interests you?
messages.courseSelected: Great choice! {course} is designed around real production workflows.
messages.askName: Got it. What's your full name?
messages.askPhone: Thanks {name}! Your WhatsApp number for {course} details, roadmap & fees?
messages.askTiming: When do you plan to start {course}?
messages.summary: Perfect {name}! You're interested in {course} - {shortDesc}. This is {level} level, you'll build production projects with mentor reviews and get a verifiable certificate + portfolio. Our team will contact you on {phone}. Want syllabus on WhatsApp instantly?
messages.confirmationWhatsapp: Awesome {name}! Your lead is recorded. Click below to chat directly with our admissions engineer on WhatsApp, or our team will reach out to {phone} shortly.
messages.confirmationEmail: Thank you {name}! Your request has been sent to our mentoring team. We will send the syllabus, project blueprints and roadmap to {phone}.
messages.confirmationBoth: Fantastic {name}! We've saved your request and queued your syllabus. Tap below to connect immediately on WhatsApp with our engineers, or expect our message on {phone}.
messages.errorGeneric: Something went wrong saving your details, but don't worry! You can also WhatsApp us directly.
messages.restartGreeting: Conversation restarted. Which track interests you today?
messages.selectOptionPrompt: Please select one of the quick options above to continue your path with our engineers!
